aboutpage.title: Commitment to Justice and Excellence in Fuengirola
aboutpage.intro: Érika Lizeth Morales Andrade: Registered attorney expert in offering effective legal solutions. Born in Quito, Ecuador, and graduated from the renowned Complutense University of Madrid, I hold a Master's Degree in Access to the Legal Profession from Francisco de Vitoria University. Active member of the Culture Commission of the Illustrious Bar Association of Málaga, Fuengirola Delegation.
aboutpage.philosophyText: I firmly believe in a human-centered legal practice, based on trust and transparency. Each client receives personalized treatment and a tailored legal strategy. My goal is for you to understand every step of the process, from the first consultation to the favorable resolution of your case in Fuengirola or Madrid.
aboutpage.experienceText: With a solid background in banking law and local administration (Navalcarnero City Council), I now lead my own firm focused on Immigration Law and Civil Law. I have successfully resolved numerous nationality and regularization files for international clients on the Costa del Sol.

servicespage.title: Legal Practice Areas
servicespage.subtitle: Comprehensive legal services for individuals and businesses in Fuengirola and Málaga province.
servicespage.civilText: Experts in debt claims, drafting and reviewing rental and purchase contracts, evictions, and civil liability. We protect your assets.
servicespage.familyText: Empathetic advice on divorces (mutual agreement and contentious), custody measures, alimony, and comprehensive management of inheritances and wills.
servicespage.penalText: Rigorous legal defense in speedy trials, minor offenses, drunk driving, and gender violence. 24h assistance to detainees in police stations and courts.
servicespage.immigrationText: Specialist in Spanish Nationality (by residence, option, democratic memory), Residency (social, work, family roots), Family Reunification, Community Card and Golden Visas.

officeInfo.title: Our Law Firm
officeInfo.p1: We are a growing multidisciplinary law firm, specialized in immigration law and dedicated to administrative, civil, criminal, labor, and social security law. Our goal is to provide a comprehensive and personalized service, tailored to each client’s needs. We advise and manage all types of legal procedures, as well as applications for grants and subsidies, always ensuring a close, professional, and efficient approach.

officeInfo2.title: Trusted Collaborators and Partners
officeInfo2.p2: At our main office in Fuengirola, we collaborate with the accounting firm Pérez y Porras and with the notary office of Pablo Pol Seijas, both fully trusted partners. We also work with several insurance brokerages across Spain, such as Fuengirola Brokers, among others.

officeInfo3.title: Multilingual Service for Our Clients
officeInfo3.p3: We offer translation services in English, French, and many other languages, providing linguistic support for both official documents and communications with clients or international partners.
